headline: TEX @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.34 at TOR 4.77, with a projected total of 9.12. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: TEX moved -0.15 runs while TOR moved +0.62, changing the projected margin by -0.77 runs. The projected total climbed +0.47, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Wyatt Langford, Brandon Nimmo, Jake Burger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
